units: metres, degrees; dimensioned source drawings are in mm

provenance.field: 4.1, printed pp32,35-36: 28 x 15 m; crossfall permitted 1-2 deg; nominal choice 1.5 deg; wall 2.4 m.
provenance.trapezoid: Fig4-27 p54: footprint segments and heights 200/400 mm, slopes 43/23 deg. Ramp access placement and high pad subdivision are approximations.
provenance.central: Fig4-28 p55: 7700 x 9939 main footprint envelope, heights 200/300 mm and 10.5 deg entry. Unspecified corner offsets/interior subdivision approximated.
provenance.inner: Fig4-29/30 p56: 12/14/15/45 deg and 2060 dimension. Inner width/placement is a simplified collision envelope, not the complete assembly drawing.
provenance.tunnel: Fig4-35 p60 section A: 800 outer / 700 inner / 260 vertical clearance, local road floor as datum. Length 650 and wall/roof thickness are modelling assumptions, not fully dimensioned passage details.
provenance.fly: Fig4-38 p62: 17 deg, 650 gap, 200 landing, 553/203 ramp levels; run derived from rise/tan(17deg). 1143 outer and 860 lane adopted from plan. Placement approximated from Fig4-5.
provenance.rough: Fig4-37 p61: 70 mm interpreted as total panel envelope; 240 mm spans two crests, hence nominal pitch120. Base/crest split and cosine profile are assumptions pending CAD/field measurement; do not treat as exact physical surface.
provenance.fortress: Fig4-26 p53: hex edge lengths1120/653mm, outer/inner flat-to-flat1939/1131mm and height150mm. Exact footprint/height imply about20.35deg, within stated nominal20deg and drawing tolerances.
provenance.contact: Engineering assumptions only. PVC/wood stiffness, friction, restitution and tolerances require measured calibration; not specified by the PDF.
provenance.layout: Centre-symmetric coarse layout from Fig4-5, exact dimensioned feature sizes preserved where identified. This is a motion-terrain prototype, not a certified full CAD reconstruction. Base stations and other non-driving props use simplified collision envelopes.
provenance.reference: z=0 at centre ridge, base floor z=-abs(y)*tan(crossfall). Feature levels are relative to the local tilted floor, not global z. x along28m, y along15m.
